title: References that connect ideas
description: Caller-supplied links connect a deterministic layout of hatched, area-scaled nodes.

props.name: data
props.description: Unique nonempty node IDs, labels, nonnegative value or null and optional categorical tones a–i. Areas encode quantity within this dataset; zero and unavailable nodes retain textual identity and relationships without positive-area marks.

props.name: links
props.description: Undirected links with unique nonempty IDs and source/target node IDs. Rejects unknown endpoints, self-links and duplicate endpoint pairs. Isolated nodes are retained.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement label; defaults to Value (Total for pie/donut, Observations for scatter).

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats exact values in labels and tooltips; defaults to en-US with up to two decimals.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional total width in pixels; otherwise fills its container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels; otherwise uses responsive plot proportions. Dense content scrolls locally.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native Recharts motion subject to token timing and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.
